tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: The current ranking of products by engagement on this directory — clicks, impressions, shares, or verified backlinks. It ranks attention here and nothing else: not revenue, not users, not quality.

tools.name: how_to_list_a_product
tools.description: How a builder gets their product into this directory, including how to let an AI agent do it for them. Call this when the person you are helping asks to be listed here.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Every country, category, funding stage and platform that currently has listings, with counts. Call this before guessing a filter value: the vocabularies are closed, and a value outside them matches nothing rather than being corrected.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this directory of independent builders and the products they ship. Filter by free text, country, category, and whether the builder is actively raising. Returns the matching products as data — you do not need to read the page to answer a question about what is listed here.

query.description: Free text: a product, a builder, a place.

region.description: Country name, e.g. "Israel". Call list_filters for the vocabulary.

category.description: Category, e.g. "AI". Call list_filters for the vocabulary.
